# Pipeline CRM pricing built for growing sales teams
## Pipeline CRM pricing at a glance
Pipeline CRM costs $25 to $49 per user per month (billed annually) across three standard plans: Start ($25), Develop ($33), and Grow ($49). Monthly billing is available at $29, $39, and $59 per user per month. Enterprise pricing is custom. Every plan includes pipeline management, contact management, deal and activity reporting, and unlimited file storage; a 14-day free trial runs on the Grow plan with no credit card required. Premium add-ons like Data Enrichment and Email Validation are flat monthly fees available on any tier, and Pipeline Phone calling is pay as you go.

How much does Pipeline CRM cost?

What are my billing options?

However, more than 60 types of currency can be chosen when you subscribe to the Grow plan.

Pipeline integrates with the most used business cloud software tools from email, accounting software, to project management. [Browse the full integrations library](https://pipelinecrm.com/features/integrations/) to see what connects today, or have our team set everything up for you with our [managed CRM integration service](https://pipelinecrm.com/features/pipeline-connect/).

## Pricing FAQs

Can’t find the answer you’re looking for? [Contact our team](https://pipelinecrm.com/contact-us/).

How much does Pipeline CRM cost?

Pipeline CRM has three standard plans, priced per user per month: Start ($25), Develop ($33), and Grow ($49), all billed annually. Monthly billing is available at $29, $39, and $59 per user per month. Enterprise pricing is custom. Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial, no credit card required.

What happens during the free trial?

During your 14-day free trial, you will be on the Grow plan to experience the full breadth of CRM capabilities we offer. You can have an unlimited number of seats during the trial period as well, because everyone should experience what a Pipeline CRM can do for sales.

Can I try different plans during my trial?

No, during your free trial, you will be on the Grow plan to fully experience all of the CRM capabilities Pipeline offers.

What is the difference between annual and monthly billing?

Annual billing lowers the per-user rate: Start is $25 instead of $29, Develop is $33 instead of $39, and Grow is $49 instead of $59 per user per month. On a Grow plan that saves $120 per user every year. Annual plans are billed once per year; monthly plans renew month to month.

What are my billing options?

Most of our customers use a credit card to pay for monthly or annual fees. We also have annual invoicing. If you have another preferred payment method, [get in touch with our sales team](https://pipelinecrm.com/contact-us/).

How are premium add-ons billed?

Data Enrichment, Email Validation, and Pipeline Connect are flat monthly fees added on top of your subscription and billed together with it, and you can add or cancel them at any time. [Pipeline Phone is pay as you go](https://pipelinecrm.com/pricing/phone/): calls and phone numbers are paid from a prepaid balance, with no per-user fee. Every add-on is available on any plan tier.

How can I see a demo or speak with a sales team member?

Our sales team is based out of Seattle, Washington and we have representatives on the East Coast in Atlanta, Georgia. [Book a demo with our team](https://app.pipelinecrm.com/schedule_demo) to see Pipeline CRM in action.

What language does Pipeline come in?

Pipeline platform is available in English. However, more than 60 types of currency can be chosen when you subscribe to the Grow plan.

Will Pipeline integrate with the software tools I am currently using?

Pipeline integrates with the most used business cloud software tools from email, accounting software, to project management. [Browse the full integrations library](https://pipelinecrm.com/features/integrations/) to see what connects today, or have our team set everything up for you with our [managed CRM integration service](https://pipelinecrm.com/features/pipeline-connect/).

What if I need help to get started?

We worked hard to design the most adopted CRM among SMBs, so we understand the journey it takes to reach CRM success. We offer a series of videos and articles in our [Knowledge Base](https://help.pipelinecrm.com/) and we have a Customer Care team standing by via US-based live chat. If you are searching for more personalized service or training for your company, you can inquire about our [onboarding programs](https://pipelinecrm.com/features/onboarding-services/) managed by our Customer Success team.

data.description: Pipeline CRM has 3 main tiers: Start ($25), Develop ($33), Grow ($49/user/mo). Coevera has 4: Starter ($65), Business ($85), Enterprise ($115), ...
data.markdown:
Pipeline CRM ($25-$49/user/month) is a sales CRM for construction and mid-market teams, rated 4.4/5 on G2 from 933 reviews. Compared to Coevera ($65-$150/user/month), Pipeline CRM offers simpler tiered pricing, US-based live chat support with under 1-minute response times, and CSV/Excel data import included. If your team has fewer than 50 reps and you need a CRM under $50/user, Pipeline CRM is the better fit.

PIPELINE CRM VS COEVERA

# Coevera (formerly Pipeliner) vs Pipeline CRM

**Heads up:** In June 2026, Pipeliner CRM rebranded to **Coevera**. Throughout this page, we refer to the product as Coevera (formerly Pipeliner CRM). Pricing, plans, and product trade-offs remain the same as before the rename.

Similar names, very different CRMs. We compared Coevera and Pipeline CRM side by side: pricing, features, support quality, and real G2 reviews from 464 users. Coevera starts at $65/user. Pipeline CRM starts at $25.

[Book a demo](https://app.pipelinecrm.com/schedule_demo)

[Start a trial](https://app.pipelinecrm.com/signup)

✓ No credit card required    ✓ 14-day free trial    ✓ Cancel anytime

|  | Pipeline CRM | Coevera |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Entry price | **$25**/user/mo | $65/user/mo |
| Most popular plan | **$49**/user/mo (Grow) | $115/user/mo (Enterprise) |
| Ease of Use (G2) | **8.9/10** | 8.7/10 |
| Support Quality (G2) | **9.2/10** | 8.8/10 |
| Ease of Setup (G2) | **9.0/10** | 8.6/10 |
| Visual Pipeline | ✓ | ✓ |
| Desktop App | Cloud only | **Cloud + Desktop** |
| Minimum Users | **1 user** | 3 users ($195/mo floor) |
| Customer Support | **US-based live chat (all plans)** | Tiered by plan |
| Unique Strengths | **Sales-first simplicity** | Visual analytics + offline |

## At a Glance

Pipeline CRM is a sales CRM that offers visual pipeline management, contact and lead tracking, email tools, and sales reporting for small and mid-size teams in construction, manufacturing, and professional services, with native QuickBooks Online, Gmail, and Outlook integration. Coevera and Pipeline CRM are separate companies with similar names. Coevera focuses on visual analytics and an offline-capable desktop app for mid-market teams. Pipeline CRM is a sales-first CRM built for teams of 5 to 50. Coevera’s Starter plan ($65/user/mo) costs more than Pipeline CRM’s top-tier Grow plan ($49/user/mo). For a 10-user team, Pipeline CRM saves $1,920 to $7,920 per year depending on the tier. Pipeline CRM scores higher on G2 for support quality (9.2 vs 8.8), ease of setup (9.0 vs 8.6), and ease of admin (8.9 vs 8.5).

Last Updated: March 3, 2026 \| Based on 464 G2 reviews, hands-on testing, and verified pricing data

If you searched for “Coevera” and landed here, you’re not alone. The two names cause real confusion in search results, and Coevera receives 2,200+ monthly search impressions that lead to Pipeline CRM pages. Despite the similar names, these are completely separate products built by different companies for different audiences.

We’ll walk through [pricing](https://pipelinecrm.com/pricing/), features, support, and real user feedback. We’ll be honest about where Coevera wins, too. Here’s what we found.

## Quick Verdict

### Choose Pipeline CRM if:

- You want a CRM that costs 50-60% less at every tier. Pipeline CRM Grow ($49/user) delivers more features than Coevera Starter ($65/user), with no 3-user minimum
- You need fast setup with dedicated human support. Pipeline CRM rates 9.0/10 on G2 for Ease of Setup vs Coevera’s 8.6, and 9.2/10 for support quality vs Coevera’s 8.8
- You’re in construction, manufacturing, or field sales and need [Map Views, route planning](https://pipelinecrm.com/features/map-views-route-planning/), and industry-specific expertise

### Choose Coevera if:

- You need an offline-capable desktop app for areas with unreliable internet. Coevera’s desktop client syncs when you’re back online
- Your sales process involves complex org charts and multi-stakeholder deals. Coevera’s Buying Center feature maps influence relationships between contacts
- You want highly visual analytics with chart and map visualizations built into the pipeline view, and your budget supports $65-$150/user/month

## Pricing Comparison: Coevera vs Pipeline CRM

The pricing gap between these two CRMs is significant. Coevera’s cheapest plan ($65/user/mo) costs more than Pipeline CRM’s most popular plan ($49/user/mo). Coevera also requires a 3-user minimum on Starter, creating a $195/month floor before you’ve added a single deal. Pipeline CRM has no minimum user requirement on any plan.

|  | Pipeline CRM | Coevera |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Entry price | **$25/user/mo (Start)** | $65/user/mo (Starter). 3-user minimum required. |
| Mid-tier plan | **$33/user/mo (Develop)** | $85/user/mo (Business) |
| Most popular plan | **$49/user/mo (Grow)** | $115/user/mo (Enterprise) |
| Top-tier plan | Custom (Enterprise) | $150/user/mo (Unlimited) |
| Free plan | No. 14-day free trial on Grow plan, no credit card required | No. 14-day free trial, no credit card required |
| Annual billing discount | ~15% off monthly rates | ~13-15% off monthly rates |
| **Cost for 10-user team (annual, most popular plan)** | **$490/mo (Grow)** | **$1,150/mo (Enterprise)** |
| Hidden costs / add-ons | Data Enrichment $19-69/mo, Email Validation $25/mo, [Pipeline Phone](https://pipelinecrm.com/features/pipeline-phone/) calling pay as you go (from 2.5¢/min, $2/number/mo, no per-user fee), Pipeline Connect from $99/mo. All optional. | Sandbox, prioritized support, professional services, and custom data migration are all add-on purchases. API not available on Starter. |
| Onboarding cost | **CSV/Excel data import (3 business days). Onboarding training from $750.** | Implementation packages available (pricing not published). Professional services for setup and training. |

Last verified: 2026-03-03. Annual billing rates shown. Prices in USD.

### The Real Cost Picture

Coevera’s visual pipeline and desktop app are genuine strengths. If offline access is critical for your team, Coevera delivers something Pipeline CRM doesn’t offer. That’s a fair trade-off, and worth paying for if it matches your workflow.

But the pricing difference is hard to ignore. Coevera’s Starter plan ($65/user) costs **more than Pipeline CRM’s Grow plan ($49/user)**, which includes email templates, bulk email, drip campaigns, eSign, 15 lead forms, and 20 automations. None of those features are available on Coevera Starter. The 3-user minimum on Coevera Starter means you can’t start with fewer than 3 seats, creating a $195/month floor even for a solo salesperson.

For a 10-user team on each platform’s most popular plan, the math is straightforward: Pipeline CRM Grow at $490/month vs Coevera Enterprise at $1,150/month. That’s **$660/month in savings, or $7,920 per year**. Even comparing entry-level tiers (Pipeline CRM Start at $250/month vs Coevera Starter at $650/month), you save $400/month, or $4,800 per year.

As one G2 reviewer put it: “The price was fairly high for a basic CRM. We felt there were better choices for our money.”

## Feature Comparison: Coevera vs Pipeline CRM

We compared Pipeline CRM’s Grow plan ($49/user) against Coevera’s Enterprise plan ($115/user), their respective most popular tiers. Here’s what you actually get:

| Feature | Pipeline CRM (Grow, $49/user) | Coevera (Enterprise, $115/user) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Active deals | **Unlimited (all plans)** | Unlimited |
| Sales pipelines | 5 (Grow), up to 20 (Enterprise) | **Unlimited** |
| Custom fields | **Unlimited (Grow+)** | Custom fields available (limit not published) |
| Email tracking | **Unlimited (Develop+, from $33/user)** | Included (Enterprise) |
| Workflow automation | 20 automations (Grow) | **25 Automatizer processes, 10,000 runs/mo (Enterprise)** |
| Lead forms | **15 forms included (Grow)** | Not a core feature. Relies on integrations. |
| E-signatures | **Included (Grow). eSign built into Instant Docs** | Enterprise plan and above |
| Bulk email & drip campaigns | **Included (Grow)** | Email integration available. No native drip campaigns. |

## Real-World Scenarios: Who Wins?

### Scenario 1: 5-Person Sales Team on a Budget

**The situation:** A growing services company with 5 sales reps. They’ve outgrown spreadsheets and need their first CRM. Budget is under $400/month total.

**With Pipeline CRM:** Start plan at $25/user/mo = $125/month. They get 1 pipeline, 250 active deals, email tracking (250/user), goal dashboard, SSO, and CSV/Excel data import. Or Develop at $33/user = $165/month for 2 pipelines, unlimited email tracking, and 10 automations.

**With Coevera:** Starter plan at $65/user/mo = $325/month (minimum 3 users = $195/mo floor, all 5 = $325). They get core pipeline management and visual analytics. No API access, no automation (requires Business at $85/user = $425/month, over budget).

**Verdict:** Pipeline CRM delivers more features at $125-$165/month than Coevera does at $325/month. The $160-$200/month savings buys the team a year of Pipeline CRM Develop for what 3 months of Coevera Starter costs. For budget-conscious teams, this is a straightforward choice.

### Scenario 2: 15-Person Sales Team Needing Automation + Reporting

**The situation:** A B2B company with 15 reps and 3 managers. They need workflow automation, sales reporting, email sequences, and pipeline forecasting. The VP of Sales wants deal visibility across the team.

**With Pipeline CRM:** Grow plan at $49/user/mo = $735/month. They get 20 automations, Hindsight analytics, Deal Intelligence, email drip campaigns, 15 lead forms, eSign, bulk email, and CSV/Excel data import. No onboarding fee.

**With Coevera:** Enterprise plan at $115/user/mo = $1,725/month. They get 25 Automatizer processes (10,000 runs/month), visual dashboards, Buying Center, and advanced customization. Plus implementation package costs.

**Verdict:** Pipeline CRM saves this team **$990/month, or $11,880/year** ($735 vs $1,725/month). Coevera offers 5 more automation processes (25 vs 20) and the Buying Center for complex stakeholder mapping. If your sales process requires mapping influence relationships across 10+ decision-makers per deal, Coevera’s Buying Center is genuinely useful. For most 15-person B2B sales teams, Pipeline CRM delivers comparable functionality at 43% of the cost.

### Scenario 3: Construction Company with Field Sales Reps

**The situation:** A general contractor with 10 salespeople covering a metro area. Reps visit job sites daily. They need route planning, mobile access, proposal generation, and a CRM that understands long sales cycles.

**With Pipeline CRM:** Grow plan at $49/user/mo = $490/month. Map Views with 45 routes/user/month, Instant Docs for proposals, eSign for on-site contract signing, and a support team with deep [construction industry expertise](https://pipelinecrm.com/industries/construction-crm/). CSV/Excel data import.

**With Coevera:** Enterprise plan at $115/user/mo = $1,150/month. Coevera does support construction workflows. One G2 reviewer noted: “Construction jobs may take years to advance from a building design to occupancy permit. Using Coevera, we track jobs through a progression of construction phases.” However, no native route planning, and reviewers note the mobile app is weaker than the desktop experience.

**Verdict:** Both CRMs can handle construction sales cycles. Pipeline CRM has the edge with built-in Map Views for field reps, stronger mobile access, and purpose-built [construction features](https://pipelinecrm.com/features/). You save $660/month while getting tools Coevera doesn’t offer natively.

### Scenario 4: Switching from Coevera to Pipeline CRM

**The situation:** Your 10-person team has been on Coevera Enterprise for a year. You’re paying $1,150/month. The visual pipeline is nice, but your team mostly works in the cloud and rarely uses the desktop app. The cost is becoming hard to justify.

**The switch:** Pipeline CRM supports CSV/Excel import. Your contacts, deals, companies, and activity history transfer over. Average migration takes 3 business days. Pipeline views and automations need re-creation (typically 1-2 hours for most teams).

**What you save:** $660/month ($1,150 vs $490), or $7,920/year. Your team gets US-based live chat support on day one, Map Views for field reps, built-in eSign, and email drip campaigns, all included in the Grow plan.

**Verdict:** If you’re paying $115+/seat for Coevera and not using the desktop app or Buying Center, you’re paying a premium for features you don’t need. The switch to Pipeline CRM saves nearly $8,000/year for a 10-person team. [Start a free 14-day trial](https://app.pipelinecrm.com/signup) to test-drive before committing.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Find the answer to your question here. If you don’t see it, please feel free to [contact us](https://pipelinecrm.com/contact-us/).

Are Coevera and Pipeline CRM the same company?

No. Coevera (pipelinersales.com) and Pipeline CRM (pipelinecrm.com) are completely separate companies with different products, teams, and pricing. The similar names cause confusion in search results, which is why this comparison page exists. Coevera is a visual pipeline tool with a desktop app, starting at $65/user/month. Pipeline CRM is a sales-first CRM starting at $25/user/month, built for small teams in construction, manufacturing, and professional services.

Is Coevera or Pipeline CRM better for small businesses?

Pipeline CRM is the better fit for most small sales teams. Coevera’s Starter plan ($65/user) requires a 3-user minimum ($195/month floor) and doesn’t include automation, API access, or advanced reporting. Pipeline CRM’s Grow plan ($49/user) includes email templates, bulk email, eSign, drip campaigns, 15 lead forms, and 20 automations, all with no minimum user requirement. G2 scores confirm it: Pipeline CRM leads on support (9.2 vs 8.8), setup ease (9.0 vs 8.6), and admin ease (8.9 vs 8.5).

How much does Coevera cost compared to Pipeline CRM?

For a 10-user team on the most popular plan, Pipeline CRM Grow costs $490/month vs Coevera Enterprise at $1,150/month, saving $7,920/year. Pipeline CRM has 3 main tiers: Start ($25), Develop ($33), Grow ($49/user/mo). Coevera has 4: Starter ($65), Business ($85), Enterprise ($115), Unlimited ($150/user/mo). Coevera’s cheapest plan ($65) costs more than Pipeline CRM’s most expensive standard plan ($49). Pipeline CRM has no mandatory onboarding fees and supports CSV/Excel import on every plan.

Can I migrate from Coevera to Pipeline CRM?

Yes. Pipeline CRM supports CSV/Excel import for contacts, deals, companies, notes, and activity history; most teams complete migration in about 3 business days. Pipeline views and automations need manual re-creation (typically 1-2 hours for most teams). Onboarding training packages start at $750. [Start a free trial](https://app.pipelinecrm.com/signup) to test with your real data before switching.

Which CRM has better customer support: Coevera or Pipeline CRM?

Pipeline CRM wins on support quality. On G2, Pipeline CRM scores 9.2/10 for support quality vs Coevera’s 8.8/10. Pipeline CRM provides US-based live chat on every plan, including the $25/user Start tier. Coevera offers support on all plans but reserves premium/prioritized support for the Unlimited tier ($150/user/month). Pipeline CRM also scores higher as a “Good Business Partner” on G2 (9.1 vs 8.7). One Coevera reviewer noted issues with their cancellation policy, describing threats of legal action over a missed cancellation window.

Which CRM has better reporting and visual analytics?

It depends on what you prioritize. Coevera excels at visual analytics with chart and map visualizations built directly into the pipeline view. Reviewers praise its “dynamic views for data” and visual customization. Pipeline CRM Grow ($49/user) includes Goal Dashboard, Hindsight (pipeline trend analysis), and Deal Intelligence, purpose-built for sales managers who want clear pipeline health metrics. If highly visual, chart-heavy dashboards are critical, Coevera has an edge. For actionable sales metrics at a fraction of the cost, choose Pipeline CRM.

Which CRM is better for construction companies?

Pipeline CRM. It’s purpose-built for construction sales with Map Views (45 routes/user/month on Grow), Instant Docs for proposals, and eSign for on-site contract signing. Its support team has deep [construction industry expertise](https://pipelinecrm.com/industries/construction-crm/). Coevera can handle construction workflows (one reviewer tracked jobs through construction phases), but it lacks route planning and field-specific tools. For construction companies, Pipeline CRM offers more relevant features at less than half the cost.

Does Coevera’s desktop app matter if my team works from the office?

Probably not. Coevera’s offline-capable desktop app is a genuine advantage for teams in areas with unreliable internet or frequent travel to remote locations. But if your team works from an office or has reliable connectivity, a cloud-only CRM like Pipeline CRM offers the same accessibility from any browser or mobile device without installing software. Most G2 reviewers praise Coevera’s desktop experience but note the mobile app is weaker, suggesting the value is tied to the desktop, not mobility.
